summary.zh: 在合并前发起评审，确认实现满足需求
summary.en: Request review before merging to confirm requirements are met.

description.zh: 在功能做完或准备合并时组织评审，说明改动范围与需要重点看的地方，让评审聚焦真实风险而不是格式细节。适合阶段完成与合并前的检查。
description.en: Organises a review once a feature is done or a merge is near, scoping the change and calling out where scrutiny matters, so feedback targets real risk rather than style. Fits milestone checks and pre-merge gates.
